description: Identifies one XRP Ledger token from the validated ledger: a trust-line token (currency code plus issuer) or a multi-purpose token (48-hex issuance id). Reports the type, issuer domain check, supply, and controls that can freeze, lock, claw back, or restrict holders. Issuer-written metadata is quoted and is not treated as fact; a missing asset class is reported missing. Does not check other chains, and does not rate legal backing or solvency. Useful before accepting an MPT or any other token. The first call each day returns the real answer without payment. After that, about $0.01 via x402 (USDC on Base, or XRP / RLUSD on the XRP Ledger). A payment watch is paid from the first call. Bad input and ledger outages are never charged.

currency.description: Trust-line token code, with issuer. Not XRP.

mpt_issuance_id.description: 48-hex multi-purpose token issuance id. Use this or currency plus issuer, not both.
